versions.changelog:
v1.1.1: Security & Privacy documentation (no functional changes)
This release adds explicit security and privacy disclosures to address how the
Skill handles two capabilities flagged as high-risk by automated security scans:
local credential access (Feishu) and optional external LLM communication.
What's new:
- scripts/feishu_fetcher.py: Added SECURITY & PRIVACY DISCLOSURE block
  explaining credential scope (only channels.feishu.accounts[].appId/appSecret),
  in-memory-only usage, and the network egress allowlist (open.feishu.cn only).
- scripts/enricher.py: Added SECURITY & PRIVACY DISCLOSURE block clarifying
  that LLM enrichment is OPT-IN and OFF BY DEFAULT, requires four explicit
  env vars to activate, has no hardcoded production endpoint, and that the
  base archive+index pipeline runs entirely offline.
- SKILL.md: Added a new "Security & Privacy" section documenting the three
  capability classes (local credential access / external LLM egress / file
  system writes) with a summary table of default behaviors and how to enable
  each one.
What did NOT change:
- No code logic changes. No new dependencies. No new network endpoints.
- All existing CLI arguments, env vars, output formats, and behavior are
  preserved. v1.1.1 is a drop-in replacement for v1.1.0.
Backward compatibility: 100%. Users on v1.1.0 can upgrade safely.

v1.1.0: 新增飞书云文档支持
- 新数据源：通过 --source feishu 直接抓取飞书 docx/wiki，自动识别链接并提取 doc_token
- 新功能：--split-by date 把工作日志按日期拆成单独的 daily notes
- 新增脚本：scripts/feishu_fetcher.py（飞书 API 调用 + 内容 normalize）、scripts/worklog_splitter.py（日期拆分器）
- pipeline.py 增加 run_feishu_pipeline 路由分支，并对 feishu source 的 insights 模式加 ALLOW_EXTERNAL 提醒
- 路径迁移：脚本从 ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills 改到 ~/.openclaw/shared-skills（共享给 8 只家庭 agent）
- 向后兼容 1.0.0 的本地 Word/PDF/TXT/MD 流程
v1.0.0: 大文档归档与检索管线，支持 Word/PDF/TXT/MD，三档运行模式（archive-only/+index/+insights），分块索引，断点恢复
